purpose: Define executable enrollment, fragmented delivery, synchronization completion, polling checkpoint, capability acknowledgement, rejection, compatibility, and receipt behavior shared by the TypeScript Sender and Python Portal.

inputs.name: message_bytes
inputs.description: Exact uncompressed RFC 8785 JSON bytes for one enrollment, capability advertisement, capability acknowledgement, Ingest Batch, Snapshot Completion, Change Completion, Sync Checkpoint, Delivery Receipt, retryable failure, or Delivery Block message.

inputs.name: supported_versions
inputs.description: The Wire Protocol Versions and per-record-type Source Projection schema versions accepted by the evaluating participant.

inputs.name: capability_state
inputs.description: The honored capability generations with their supported versions and record-count and uncompressed-byte limits, any proposed advertisement, and the latest generation whose capability acknowledgement has been accepted.

inputs.name: delivery_history
inputs.description: Accepted Sender Installation sequence identities, message hashes, per-cycle fragment-chain values, accepted completions, and any sequence gaps needed to evaluate a delivery.

outputs.name: canonical_message
outputs.description: Exact versioned RFC 8785 JSON bytes and lowercase SHA-256 identity for a valid message.

outputs.name: decoded_message
outputs.description: One closed typed protocol value with no unknown interpretation.

outputs.name: delivery_receipt
outputs.description: A durable-acceptance value echoing Sender Installation, monotonic sequence, and exact message SHA-256.

outputs.name: sequence_gap
outputs.description: The last previously accepted sequence when an accepted message follows a gap, reported for the Portal to record without changing the receipt.

outputs.name: retryable_failure
outputs.description: A named outcome with one closed reason, for a condition in which identical bytes may be attempted again.

outputs.name: delivery_block
outputs.description: A named Operator-action-required outcome that preserves the original head message and prevents later delivery.

outputs.name: staging_refusal
outputs.description: A named Sender-side refusal to stage a fragment, leaving nothing queued and the record type blocked.

outputs.name: compatibility_decision
outputs.description: Exactly one of accept, capability-generation-regression, or capability-contraction-blocked for a proposed capability advertisement.

owns: wire message schemas and exact byte representation
message identity, fragment partitioning, and fragment-chain calculations
closed Sync Checkpoint and retryable-failure value lists
transport-independent receipt, retryable failure, and Delivery Block values
does_not_own: Health Connect reads or Source Projection bytes and semantics
when empty cycles or capability acknowledgements are staged
HTTP, Tailscale, Authorized Ingress establishment, or unknown transport outcomes
Portal archival transactions, retryable-failure issuance, or Sender Installation lifecycle
health interpretation, summary publication, export, backup, or deletion
